purpose: Illustrated Ink replay segmentation and image prompt controls for Low Sere's empty-spindle review and return-mark fixture.

visual_scene_plan.purpose: Click-through visual anchors for the Cistern House, ordinary water accounting, intake office holders, a darkening shutter mark, vacancy procedure, commoner claim receipt, final priority, and four ending families.
visual_scene_plan.segmentation_rule: Use separate visual_scene_id anchors for the room, office holders, Bel's routine, preparation, the single-sentence shutter failure, emergency power geometry, empty-spindle response, claim receipt, final threshold, and each ending family. The shutter mark going dark stands alone in replay.
visual_scene_plan.prompting_rule: Each base image prompt stands alone, describes visible high-fantasy geometry and objects in ordinary language, and includes only characters or groups declared visible. Continuity notes remain tooling constraints rather than prompt text.
visual_scene_plan.global_style_cue: Style: hand-painted high-fantasy interactive-fiction illustration, gouache and ink on textured paper, sharp readable silhouettes, cold grey stone and mineral water, warm mist and amber lamplight, restrained relic mystery, practical worn tools, expressive grounded body language, abstract unlettered record marks.
visual_scene_plan.prompt_assembly_rule: Assemble every generated prompt from global_style_cue, the visual scene base_image_prompt, visual_character_refs only for named characters and groups visible in that frame, and every triggered state or global branch modifier. Use a camera-specific scene-set render as visual input before continuity-critical website rendering.

scene_set_guidance.scope_reason: The fixture returns to one Cistern House from several focal distances and changes spindle, board, witness, water, and character positions. The textual scene map supports review and blockout construction; it is not geometry authority for final multi-angle art.
scene_set_guidance.future_scene_set_need: Build a durable plan view or simple blockout for the Cistern House with paired basins, broad stone lip, sampling run, drain wheel, notice wall, west-basin grate, inner stair, black pressure door, stone spindle cradle, witness boundary, and routes to Warm Steps and Grey Beds.

scenes.base_image_prompt: Wide interior view of Low Sere's Cistern House, a low heavy stone hall built across two rectangular settling basins. Warm grey water steams in the east basin beneath black timber beams; the west basin is shallow and crossed by a broad waist-high stone lip used as a public worktable. Marked ceramic vessels, damp clay strips, ash cloth filters, wooden work-watch tiles, ration boards, tools, and duplicate service notices line the walls. A large iron drain wheel stands at the west side. Behind an inner stone wall, a short stair descends to a black pressure door with three pale shutter indicators and a carved stone cradle. Bel Orra climbs in from the Warm Steps carrying two marked vessels, her layered work wrap darkened by mist.

visible_characters.default_stance: entering from the Warm Steps passage with one vessel at each side

visual_continuity_notes: The east basin carries warm grey incoming water; the west basin, drain wheel, broad lip, iron grate, inner stair, black pressure door, notice wall, sampling ledge, and spindle cradle retain fixed relative positions.
Low Sere record marks are abstract scored lines, vessel marks, tiles, cloth knots, and simple symbols; the images do not require readable modern text.

visual_character_refs.purpose: Stable named-character and group visual identities for prompt assembly. Include only refs for characters visible in a scene.

characters.bel_orra: Bel Orra: baseline human lower-step water witness, adult with a compact work-hardened build, medium-brown skin weathered by mineral mist, short dark hair wrapped in a faded grey head cloth, layered brown and slate work wraps, rope belt carrying two marked ceramic vessels, cracked hands, direct squared posture, sleeves and lower hem damp from the Warm Steps.
characters.sera_venn: Sera Venn: baseline human provisional intake custodian, adult with a lean exhausted build, warm-brown skin, long black hair braided close then loosened by damp work, charcoal robe layered over a fitted leather service apron, ash-grey gloves, eight-tooth spindle carried with both hands, posture precise even when shoulders and forearms tremble.
characters.maro_seln: Maro Seln: baseline human cistern reeve, broad adult with deep-brown skin, close-cropped greying hair, square practical face, heavy undyed wool coat over a dark work tunic, iron drain key and blunt clay scoring tool at belt, body angled between wheel and board, authority expressed through planted feet and economical hand movements.
characters.ressa_orr: Ressa Orr: baseline human itinerant Techpriest and Eighth Baffle witness, tall wiry adult with umber skin, shaved temples and a long salt-black braid, layered charcoal travelling robes under a weathered ochre tool mantle, ceramic gauge beads and folded formula cloths at belt, narrow hands marked by old heat scars, posture exact and deliberately separate from the spindle.
characters.teren_vey: Teren Vey: baseline human removed custodian, older adult with angular brown face, iron-grey beard cut short, faded black service robe under a patched cold-weather cloak, empty tool loops at the waist, shoulders held rigid behind the witness rail, gaze repeatedly drawn toward the spindle he can no longer touch.
characters.tavi_kes: Tavi Kes: baseline human speaker for the Ash Names, adult with dark copper skin, tightly curled black hair threaded with two ash-white cords, plain deep-grey mourning wrap, two pale knotted name cloths wound around one wrist, still upright posture and hands that close protectively around cloth rather than tools.

groups.lower_step_witnesses: Lower-step and Grey Bed witnesses: baseline human adults in patched wool and woven reed work wraps darkened by warm mist, cracked work hands, practical boots or wrapped feet, carrying cold medicinal moss, marked ceramic vessels, a slotted wooden delivery board, rolled wet bedding, and household water buckets; tired bodies arranged in a close mutual-witness cluster.

review_notes: Narrative and lore reviews accepted the revised scene after Tavi's introduction, Bel's authority demotion, and separation of the current reduction notice from the copied Grey Scald warning.

Visual review accepted segmentation, standalone affirmative prompts, visible-character refs, and branch deltas after success-state objects were removed from shared ending bases. It returns needs_revision for replay readiness because a durable camera-specific scene-set blockout is required and absent.
Spatial review accepted the textual fixed-zone, sightline, camera-slot, object-custody, and branch-state plan; the six-person dry lip limit keeps larger witness groups at the rail and passages.
The prompt manifest is ready, while continuity-critical rendered replay remains blocked on scene-set construction.
